claims: Scarpetta Season 2 is confirmed for Prime Video.
Scarpetta received an early two-season order.
Filming for Scarpetta Season 2 began around March 9, 2026.
Showrunner Liz Sarnoff revealed the second season will blend past and present.
Showrunner Liz Sarnoff revealed the second season picks up immediately from the Season 1 finale cliffhanger.
Showrunner Liz Sarnoff revealed the second season will dive into the consequences of Dr. Kay Scarpetta killing a copycat killer.
Nicole Kidman is expected to return as Kay for Scarpetta Season 2.
Jamie Lee Curtis is expected to return as Dorothy for Scarpetta Season 2.
Ariana DeBose is expected to return as Lucy for Scarpetta Season 2.
Bobby Cannavale is expected to return as Pete Marino for Scarpetta Season 2.
Simon Baker is expected to return as Benton for Scarpetta Season 2.
Scarpetta is based on Patricia Cornwell’s series.
Cruel and Unusual is book #4 in Patricia Cornwell’s series.
The Body Farm is book #5 in Patricia Cornwell’s series.
